Last Ecstasy.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the target unit is a MONSTER, roll 10 dice instead. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

Overwhelming Acquiescence.effect: Until the start of your next turn, weapons used by friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units for attacks that target that enemy unit, including Companion weapons, have Crit (2 Hits).

Hysterical Frenzy.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Gaze Upon My Magnificence And Weep.declare: If this unit has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

options.name: Adulate
options.text: Until the start of your next turn, while the target is in combat with this unit, it must pick this unit to be the target of pile-in moves it makes.

options.name: Reject
options.text: Inflict D3+3 mortal damage on the target, then Heal (X) this unit, where X is the number of damage points inflicted on the target this turn by this ability.

Unholy Symbiosis.effect: If you picked a SYBARITE target, subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by its combat attacks until the start of your next turn. If you picked a DAEMON target, it has WARD (5+) until the start of your next turn.

Disharmonious Song.declare: Pick each visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit that did not use a CHARGE or FIGHT ability this turn to be the target.
Disharmonious Song.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. You can re-roll the dice if the target is a WIZARD or PRIEST. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

options.name: Heart of a Shadow Daemon
options.text: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly non-MONSTER HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them.

options.name: Blood of an Aelven Princeling
options.text: Each time a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a RUN ability, if you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

options.name: Crushed Incarnate's Core
options.text: Add 1 to unbinding rolls and banishment rolls for this unit.

options.name: Unspeakable Viscera
options.text: Inflict D6 mortal damage on each other unit (friendly and enemy) within this unit's combat range.

Blissbrew Homonculus.effect:
This unit's Blissbrew Homonculi are tokens. There is 1 Blissbrew Homonculus for every 10 models in this unit.


This unit has WARD (6+) while it has any Blissbrew Homonculi. If you make an unmodified ward roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of this unit's Blissbrew Homonculi from the battlefield (the damage point is still inflicted).

Bestial Onslaughted.declare: Pick this unit if it is waiting in ambush.
Bestial Onslaughted.name: Bestial Onslaught

Share the Pain.effect: This unit has WARD (5+) while it is in combat. In addition, each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit for a damage point inflicted by a combat attack, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

Atrocious Ministrations.effect: You can allocate 1 damage point to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point). Then, roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target can use CHARGE abilities even if they used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

False Serenity.effect: While this unit has not charged this turn, it has WARD (5+).

The More Glorious Slaughter.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by units in the regiment of the unit using this ability.

The Swifter Surge.effect: For the rest of the phase, when making charge rolls for units in the regiment of the unit using this ability, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

Court of the Godlings > Summon Manifesta.declare: Pick a friendly COURT OF THE GODLINGS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

The Decadent Host > Summon Manifestation.declare: Pick a friendly DECADENT HOST WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Perfection Made Manifest.declare: Pick the friendly Sigvald to use this ability then pick a visible unit (friendly or enemy) within 3" of him to be the target.
Perfection Made Manifest.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. For each model slain by this ability this turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the friendly Sigvald's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

Excess Of Agility.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE PARAGON that has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn to use this ability.

Cutting Barbs.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO that has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with that HERO to be the target.

Chief Of Revels.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is a PARAGON, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.
